scope: Give the Schedule status checkbox set an accessible group name without changing its visual rendering or command path.

verified_gap.issue: The Schedule status options each had an individual native label, but their shared visible label was not programmatically associated with the checkbox set.
verified_gap.impact: Assistive technology exposed the checkboxes individually without the context that they form the Schedule status filter.

implementation.change: The status grid has role=group and aria-labelledby pointing to an item-specific label id. Existing schedule.config.set routing, labels, CSS, Save and Publish behavior are unchanged.
implementation.reuse_review: Uses native ARIA semantics; no third-party component or dependency is needed for this small group-label relationship.

acceptance.result: PASS 2/2 real Chromium scenarios at 390px and 1366px
checks: The Schedule checkbox grid is exposed as one group named Státuszok.
Each option remains an individually labelled native checkbox.
Existing Schedule field commands, draft Save, separate Publish, Undo/Redo and IME lifecycle remain correct.
